stone: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Asset type: one production UI resource icon, transparent RGBA PNG. From the attached ORIGINAL Gatefall style board, extract and faithfully redraw ONLY the golden faceted mineral resource cluster at the upper right, immediately left of the teal crystal. Preserve its warm gold facets, chunky mineral silhouette, broad hand-painted value planes, soft upper-left light and premium 2.5D rendering. One single centered icon on a truly transparent background, square framing, generous 12 percent clear padding, fully visible silhouette. No words, border, card, other object, pedestal, environment, detached cast shadow, black/white/checkerboard background or baked glow rectangle. Intended to read at32 to96 pixels in game. The entire golden mineral should fill about75 percent of canvas height. Keep it unmistakably a gold mineral resource, distinct from the tall split teal catalyst. Return only this one isolated original game icon.

spear1: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Asset type: one production tower sprite, transparent RGBA PNG. From the attached ORIGINAL Gatefall style board, extract and faithfully redraw ONLY the far-left GOLD SPEAR EMITTER tower, basic level1. Preserve the exact design identity: one tall sharply pointed golden crystal, dark graphite-blue split supporting ribs, warm brass collar, compact layered square concrete socket base. Match the reference's three-quarter orthographic camera and upper-left soft light, broad hand-painted3D volumes, restrained bevels, readable simple silhouette. One isolated complete tower centered in portrait4:5 framing with12 percent clear padding at all sides, entire base and crystal tip visible. No labels, no other towers, no resource stones, no UI, no ground plane outside its own compact concrete base, no surroundings, no attached cast shadow beyond the base, no black/white/checkerboard background. The actual base's ground contact must be horizontally centered. Keep the simple level1 design without extra barrels, flags, tiny gold filigree or floating accessories. Genuine transparent alpha. Return only this one original production game sprite.
impact: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Asset type: a single reusable hand-painted2D impact sprite with genuine transparent alpha. From the original Gatefall concept sheet, reproduce ONLY the bright sharp contact-impact shape, third stage in the lower-left four-stage attack FX strip. One centered compact gold-white four-point impact star with4 main tapered directional rays and a small handful of very short angular secondary strokes, elegant curved brush edges, crisp bright center, restrained soft inner glow. Square framing,20 percent clear padding, every ray fully visible. Static single effect sprite, not an animation sheet. No text, arrows, ground, scene, devices, UI, black/white/checkerboard background or solid square haze. This will be alpha-tinted by the game's effect shader, so concentrate on a clean readable alpha silhouette and keep the center bright. No broad full-screen bloom, no fireworks cloud, no extra separate effects. Return only one isolated original impact sprite.
spear2: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: level2 variant of the attached ORIGINAL Gatefall production tower sprite. Preserve the exact transparent canvas size, orthographic camera, position, upper-left lighting, paint style, main pointed GOLD crystal, graphite-blue body, material palette and especially the concrete base footprint and its pixel placement. Make it visibly one upgrade higher in the SAME tower family: add a second sturdy warm-brass reinforcing band around the lower-middle body, and a pair of short gold/brass support shoulders below the upper collar. The new pieces should be simple large shapes readable at small game scale. Preserve the height and position of the crystal tip and base; do not widen the existing base or add a ground shadow outside it. No flags, weapons, extra tower, floating pieces, runes, typography, labels, borders, background, checkerboard, blur or huge glow. Keep the same clean alpha silhouette and genuine transparent background. Only the two reinforcing upgrades should change; retain the rest of this exact tower.
